faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the RCM Bhavnagar Zonal Manager-UWM (SBM) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the RCM Bhavnagar Zonal Manager-UWM (SBM) recruitment is 14th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Zonal Manager-UWM (SBM) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Zonal Manager-UWM (SBM) post in the RCM Bhavnagar recruitment.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.E./B.Tech or M.E./M.Tech degree in Environment, Civil, Mechanical, or Water Resource engineering to be eligible.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Zonal Manager-UWM (SBM) position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 50,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to send their applications to the official address.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.answer: The selection process primarily involves Document Verification.
